core_obligations: Turn standard syntomic presentations into Koszul-regular factorizations.
Kill Koszul homology via regularity and annihilation.
Reverse: promote relative quasi-regular immersions to regular and descend to fibres.
difficulty_reason: For f : X -> S a morphism of schemes the lemma proves the equivalence (with the chapter slogan 'A morphism is flat and lci if and only if it is syntomic'): (1) f flat and lci, (2) f syntomic. The retained proof is complete and doubly given: a one-line affine appeal to More on Algebra, lemma syntomic-lci, plus the promised geometric proof — syntomic gives local standard-syntomic presentations whose defining sequences are regular in every local ring (Algebra, lemma relative-global-complete-intersection-conormal), the Koszul complex then has vanishing positive homology by the local-regularity criterion plus the homotopy annihilation lemma, so U -> V factors as Koszul-regular immersion into affine space followed by smooth; conversely flat-lci gives flat finitely presented (chapter lemma lci-properties), the relative quasi-regular immersion X -> P becomes regular after a Divisors neighbourhood lemma and stays regular under base change, so fibre local rings are complete intersections. Retained author proof at lines 18257-18303.
